script.code:
SELECT g.gr_status, g.gr_no,
       CAST(l.po_line_item_id AS CHAR) AS po_line_id, SUM(l.received_qty) AS qty
  FROM goods_receiving g
  LEFT JOIN goods_receiving_eg6l4ywi_sub l
    ON l.goods_receiving_id = g.id AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.po_line_item_id IS NOT NULL
   AND NOT (COALESCE(l.is_split, '') = 'Yes' AND COALESCE(l.parent_or_child, '') = 'Parent')
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = {{node:code_node_GcPrep.data.grId}}
   AND g.is_deleted = 0
 GROUP BY g.gr_status, g.gr_no, l.po_line_item_id

script.code:
SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(p.purchase_order_id AS CHAR) AS po_id,
       p.quantity, p.received_qty, p.created_received_qty
  FROM (SELECT sel.lid
          FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_node_GcPrep.data.poLineCsv}}', ']'),
                          '$[*]' COLUMNS (lid BIGINT PATH '$')) sel
        UNION
        SELECT l.po_line_item_id
          FROM goods_receiving_eg6l4ywi_sub l
         WHERE {{node:code_node_GcPrep.data.grId}} <> 0
           AND l.goods_receiving_id = {{node:code_node_GcPrep.data.grId}}
           AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.po_line_item_id IS NOT NULL) ids
  JOIN purchase_order_2ukyuanr_sub p ON p.id = ids.lid AND p.is_deleted = 0
  JOIN purchase_order h ON h.id = p.purchase_order_id AND h.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'

SELECT CAST(u.Item_id AS CHAR) AS item_id, CAST(u.alt_uom_id AS CHAR) AS uom_id,
       u.over_receive_tolerance AS tol
  FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_node_GcPrep.data.itemCsv}}', ']'),
                  '$[*]' COLUMNS (iid BIGINT PATH '$')) sel
  JOIN item i ON i.id = sel.iid AND i.is_deleted = 0
  JOIN item_mji552rc_sub u ON u.Item_id = i.id AND u.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND u.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'
 ORDER BY u.Item_id, u.id

script.code:
SELECT CAST(h.id AS CHAR) AS po_id,
       SUM(COALESCE(p.created_received_qty, 0) > 0) AS reserved,
       SUM(NOT (COALESCE(p.item_bundle_id, 0) <> 0 AND COALESCE(p.item_id, '') <> '')) AS countable,
       SUM(NOT (COALESCE(p.item_bundle_id, 0) <> 0 AND COALESCE(p.item_id, '') <> '')
           AND COALESCE(p.received_qty, 0) > 0) AS partially,
       SUM(NOT (COALESCE(p.item_bundle_id, 0) <> 0 AND COALESCE(p.item_id, '') <> '')
           AND COALESCE(p.received_qty, 0) > 0 AND p.received_qty >= COALESCE(p.quantity, 0)) AS fully
  FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_node_GcQty.data.relPoCsv}}', ']'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (pid BIGINT PATH '$')) sel
  JOIN purchase_order h ON h.id = sel.pid AND h.is_deleted = 0
  JOIN purchase_order_2ukyuanr_sub p ON p.purchase_order_id = h.id AND p.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'
 GROUP BY h.id
